# BRAIN ABSCESS WITH PSEUDOMONAS SPP.

Prior to beginning antimicrobial therapy, when possible, computed topographic

(CT) - guided aspiration or surgery should be performed to obtain abscess

material for determination of infectious pathogen. Adjust antimicrobial regimen

to optimize therapy based on pathogen once isolated.

# Consult Neurosurgery, Neurology, and Infectious Disease

# Duration of Therapy

Treat for a total duration of 6-8 weeks

# Treatment

Preferred:

[Cefepime 2gm IV Q8h \($$\) R](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h)

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Ceftazidime 2 gm IV q8h \($$\) R](psjizid-ceftazidime-2gm-iv-q8h)

< OR >

[Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h \($$\) R,O](psjizid-meropenem-2gm-iv-q8h)
